And the user selects the "Custom Brand" row (Lictorix Geo)
Then a website field is displayed inline right under the selected custom brand card, above "Discover Categories"

results.notes: PROD. Dropdown for "Lictorix Geo": "Lictorix Geo — Custom Brand" row + 5 Brandfetch suggestions (GET /geo/api/v1/brands/search 200; suggestion logos cdn.brandfetch.io 200). Card "L | Lictorix Geo" selected. Field data-testid=wizard-brand-website-input placed under the card (card bottom 271px, field top 339px, Discover Categories 672px). Label "What is your brand's website? (optional)", placeholder "example.com", hint "We use it to show the right logo. Leave it empty to show your brand's initial." = exact validated copy. Globe icon (svg in the field wrapper); wrapper/input classes identical to the brand search input (only the transition-duration class differs). required=false, aria-invalid=false, no asterisk, no error text.

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Lictorix Geo" is selected with an empty website field
When the user enters a full URL in the website field
And the field loses focus
Then the derived root domain is shown under the brand name
And the logo preview is retrieved for that domain

results.notes: PROD. Data per the prod smoke instructions: custom brand "Licter" (Custom Brand row; a Brandfetch suggestion "Licter licter.com" also exists, not used) and URL "https://www.licter.com/en/page?x=1" (CSV: "Lictorix Geo" / ".../fr/about?x=1", same check). Given: avatar "L", field empty. No error while typing nor after blur (aria-invalid=false, only the hint text). After blur: "licter.com" shown under "Licter"; GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com 200 {"logoUrl":"https://cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png?c=..."}; the avatar shows a licter.com logo instead of "L" (32x32). The image displayed is the Google favicon fallback, because the Brandfetch CDN answered 302 x-bf-error: automated_traffic to the headless browser (see TC-GEO-1262-001).

results.title: Confirmed domain shows the logo preview in the brand card within moments

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Lictorix Geo" is selected with an empty website field
When the user types a valid domain in the website field
And the field loses focus
Then the logo retrieved for the domain is displayed within moments
And the domain is shown under the brand name
And the logo lookup requests are recorded

results.notes: PROD, custom brand "Licter", W1 "licter.com". Avatar unchanged while typing ("L"). On blur: grey pulsing placeholder (h-8 w-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-slate-200, 32x32, no text) for ~125 ms, then the image at 32x32 (same size as a suggestion logo). The card grows 54 -> 61 px at the same moment because the domain line "licter.com" appears under the name (expected by design, not caused by the placeholder). Requests: GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com 200 (one per blur) -> cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png 302 to docs.brandfetch.com/docs/logo-link/guidelines#2-hotlinking with x-bf-error: automated_traffic -> app falls back to www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com (301 -> gstatic 200), so the avatar shows the licter.com favicon, not the Brandfetch logo. Cause = the MCP browser is HeadlessChrome: the same Brandfetch URL fetched with a desktop Chrome user agent returns 200 image/png 64x64 (purple licter logo, licter_brandfetch_realUA.png) and with the HeadlessChrome user agent the same 302 automated_traffic. PARTIAL: the Brandfetch logo display must be confirmed once in a real (non-headless) browser.

results.notes: creation not allowed in prod smoke phase 1 — logo surfaces checked on pre-release analyses. Toyota (afcdc69f) and Bosch (b1600449), both pre-release: GET /reports returns entityLogoUrl = cdn.brandfetch.io/idR0dj2M6E/... (Toyota) and /idlS72krr0/... (Bosch); both answer 410 Gone with x-bf-error: client_id_expired (also 410 with a desktop Chrome user agent, so not a headless effect). Every surface falls back to the Google favicon of the brand's own domain, consistently: report list (Bosch, Toyota), dashboard sidebar block (Toyota), Overview Brand Rankings row 4 "Toyota" (favicon toyota.com, not a cited-source favicon), Category view Hybrid Cars Brand Rankings row 1 "Toyota" (favicon toyota.com) and the Visibility / Competitive prompt rows of the category (favicon toyota.com). No separate brand logo seen in the page header. Car insurance (unbranded) shows the letter "C". All /geo/api calls 200; the only console errors are the Brandfetch 410s.
